label: pjm 27 reserve withholding
definition: STRUCTURE: pjm_26 config + as_reserve_withholding — PJM holds its measured ~3 GW Primary Reserve out of the energy stack (real market behaviour), re-solved. Offer curves NOT yet retuned to this structure, so the level still under-runs the $75-200 afternoon band — that band is the reserve opportunity-cost price, whose correct structure is energy+reserve CO-OPTIMIZATION in the LP (next build); a pre-solve headroom haircut alone can't price it. This is the structural baseline going forward, not pjm_26; calibration of the level follows once the reserve price structure is in.
